channel.title: RAN Air Wing dev blog
channel.description: HMAS Melbourne (R21) flight sim: history, carrier operations and dev diary.

item.title: Buddy refuelling: Skyhawks tanking Skyhawks
item.description: A tanker A-4G with a D-704 pod, a drogue to find with the probe, and a fuel state that makes you need it.

item.title: Firing the guns, rockets, bombs and Sidewinders
item.description: Four weapons with different sights: a gun cross, a rocket and bomb pipper, and a Sidewinder seeker that only sees tailpipes.

item.title: Loadouts: what the Skyhawk carried, and what it did not
item.description: A loadout screen with five stations, six presets, real weights and fuel, based on the A-4G's actual stores.

item.title: Missions and training: the sim now has a structure
item.description: Eleven scored missions, from a catapult launch to a maritime strike, unlock in order and keep your best score.

item.title: A more detailed S-2 Tracker
item.description: The Tracker model has been rebuilt from the reference photographs: a lofted fuselage, glazed cockpit, tapered wings, round engine nacelles and RAN markings.

item.title: Phase 1: a carrier at sea, in your browser
item.description: The first build was just the ship: ocean, hull, motion and cameras, with no aircraft yet.

item.title: Hide the menu and readouts for a clear view
item.description: A new Menu button, or the P key, hides every panel and key hint so the carrier fills the screen. Built mainly for phones.

item.title: Chase camera: orbit, pan and zoom
item.description: The chase camera is no longer fixed behind the Skyhawk. Drag to orbit, shift-drag to pan, scroll to zoom.

item.title: Welcome to RAN Air Wing
item.description: A browser flight sim of HMAS Melbourne and her air wing, set in 1977-1982, and a blog that tells the history behind it.

item.title: A jointed pilot and a longer ejection
item.description: The pilot now has a head, torso, arms and legs, and an ejection runs as a sequence from seat rocket to parachute to landing.

item.title: Fly the S-2 Tracker
item.description: The S-2 Tracker is now flyable from the catapult and onto the angled deck, with a slower, heavier propeller feel than the Skyhawk.

item.title: The task group: Perth, Derwent and Supply join Melbourne
item.description: Three escorts now keep station around the carrier, based on the task group that sailed with Melbourne in 1980.
